label: Session Context
info:
Per-client session lifecycle implemented per FAP §11 (refresh recovery rule). Receives UIBUILDER control events ('client connect' / 'client disconnect' / 'ready') via link-from-uib-control and maintains flow.context().get('sessions') keyed by _socketId. Each entry tracks connectedAt, conversationHistory (last 20 messages), and preferences.

Also implements:
  - bootstrap.session FAP action — returns initial view-model on first command after connect.
  - GET /api/v1/_internal/connections — operator endpoint reporting live connection count + per-session metadata. Used by smoke-browser-console.mjs and surfaced as the reviewer's 'real connection count' gate.
  - 5-minute watchdog interval — prunes any session entry older than 1h (failsafe against missed disconnect events).

FAP Guideline reference: §8 (sessionId state block), §11 (refresh and recovery), §19 (Refresh recovery works).
